unsafe_justifications.justification: The sole production unsafe block consumes the private completed-run capability created by execute::run from a ValidatedProgram after strict EOF, schema validation and immutable owner verification. Publication checks both owner lengths fit u32 and revalidates all raw spans and string references, including UTF-8 and exact scalar counts. The witnessed fingerprint, exact owners and unchanged slots move into ValidatedSlots with no intervening fallible operation. No public capability constructor is added. Public ABI mutation caveats are documented.

The test-only source has one fixed, inspected 50-byte strict JSON document, a fixed two-byte decoded arena and fourteen fixed events. There is no caller-provided event or payload constructor. Spans and Unicode scalar counts describe these immutable buffers exactly. EOF follows every event and transfer returns the exact owners; injected failures only deny success. Runtime and schema policies remain enforced by the VM.

selection: Empty selection captures all; exact membership includes FieldId(0), 65536 and u32::MAX without narrowing.

First and last valid indices; index equal to length; u32::MAX; empty slot slices.

publication: Owner length conversion accepts zero and u32::MAX; 64-bit-only vectors reject u32::MAX + 1 and usize::MAX without allocating large buffers.
Raw spans reject empty ranges, out-of-bounds ends and overflowing offset-plus-length arithmetic.
String references validate the designated owner, empty ranges at owner ends, multi-byte UTF-8, supplementary scalars, combining marks and decoded NUL.
Invalid leading bytes, overlong encodings, surrogate encodings, truncated UTF-8 and incorrect scalar counts fail with precise error codes and raw-safe offsets.
Publication preserves exact payload, decoded arena and slot allocation pointers and the witnessed program fingerprint.
Late invalid slots and test-only corruption of genuine completed runs fail before proof issuance, including shortened payload and decoded owners.
